card.title: 141. GEBIRGSJÄGER
card.text: Cannot be targeted by enemy orders.
card.flavorText: The 141st Gebergjäger Regiment (e. 141st Mountaineer Regiment) was part of the 6. Gebirgs Division (e. 6th Mountain Division) of the Wehrmacht during WWII. In 1940 the division was deployed in France, and later Poland for occupation duties. In 1941 the division participated in Operation Marita, which was the invasion of Greece, and that same year it was relocated to Lapland (northern Finland). In 1942 the 6. Gebirgs Division became part of the 20th Mountain Army that operated along the Arctic coast. In 1944 the division withdrew into Norway where it surrendered to the British at the end of the war in 1945.
